chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: The bus accident in Iowa
summary: A grain truck sideswiped the band bus; Cecil Irwin was killed, and Young broke his ankle.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What happened in the accident because

And we went anyway. I broke my ankle. Walter Fuller broke his jaw and his ankle. Billy Franklin, the trombone player, got hurt. He never did really get all over it and he died later. But it was a terrible accident, bus accident. Cecil died. He was sleeping with his head against the window, and the impact was right there. The guy sideswiped us. And the roads were narrow in those days. And it hit right there and broke his neck.
